title: Mary Gay Scanlon addresses government transparency and legislative updates in recent posts - South Delco News
text:
Congresswoman Mary Gay Scanlon, who represents Pennsylvania’s 5th district in the U.S. Congress, shared a series of statements on her official social media account on December 10, 2025.
In one post, Scanlon wrote: “The government COVER UP must end. The survivors deserve justice.” (December 10, 2025).
Later that day, she commented on economic issues facing Americans and criticized the President’s priorities: “Americans can’t afford health care, housing, child care, or groceries, and the President is talking about dolls and pencils. Talk about out of touch!” (December 10, 2025).
Scanlon also announced progress on legislation she sponsors: “Proud to share that my bipartisan Honoring Our Fallen Heroes Act will officially get a vote this week and is on track to be signed into law before the holidays! When passed, families of firefighters and first responders who die or are permanently disabled from service-related” (December 10, 2025).
Mary Gay Scanlon has represented Pennsylvania’s 5th District in Congress since replacing Pat Meehan in 2018. She was born in Watertown, New York in 1959 and currently resides in Swarthmore at age 63. Scanlon holds a Bachelor of Arts degree from Colgate University (1980) and earned her Juris Doctor from the University of Pennsylvania in 1984.
